name: repopilot
description: Snapshot each session and review what the agent changed before it stops: tests it skipped, focused, removed, or weakened, new lint/type suppressions, relaxed CI gates, removed auth or error handling, and untrusted input reaching risky sinks. Deterministic and local; requires the repopilot CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Stops the agent when it weakens tests, suppressions, or CI gates. Local and deterministic.
